summary: First full test iteration for SiteGenie MVP. Backend: 14/18 pytest passed. All auth, plans, and Stripe checkout flows work. Template generation is BLOCKED by an exhausted Emergent LLM key (budget_exceeded error from litellm). Frontend: Landing, Register (3 free credits granted), Dashboard, Pricing, and Stripe redirect all work. My Templates page renders. Generator UI could not be exercised end-to-end because the underlying LLM call fails.

critical.issue: LLM call fails with 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0' from litellm/emergentintegrations. The Emergent LLM key configured in backend/.env has no available budget, so no template can ever be generated. Ingress ultimately returns 502 to the client because the exception path plus litellm retries hold the connection past ingress timeout. This is a config/key problem, not application code.

minor.issue: When LLM fails, backend raises HTTPException 500 but due to slow litellm retries the client sees a 502 from the ingress instead of a fast 5xx. Consider catching sooner and returning 502/503 quickly, or disabling litellm retries.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised end-to-end because /api/templates/generate fails due to the LLM budget issue above. Frontend code posts to the correct endpoint and renders srcDoc iframe on success.

action_items: CRITICAL: Top up / rotate the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env — current key returns 'Budget has been exceeded'. Without this, no template can be generated and the entire core feature is non-functional.
After LLM key is refreshed, re-run TestTemplates in backend_test.py to validate: generate deducts 1 credit, returns full HTML (>2KB, starts with <!doctype), list/get/delete work end-to-end.

Consider adding a fast-fail path in /api/templates/generate: detect budget/quota errors from litellm and return HTTP 402/503 immediately instead of retrying and hitting ingress timeout (currently surfaces as 502).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_stripe uses str(request.base_url) which builds webhook URL from the request host — behind ingress this is fine, but it should ideally come from an env var to be deterministic.
generate_template deducts credits only AFTER LLM success — good (no credit lost on failure). No changes required.
startup seed_admin is idempotent and re-hashes password if changed — good.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. This works in browsers because FastAPI echoes the specific origin, but it is functionally 'allow everything with credentials'. Consider restricting to the deployed frontend origin for prod.

success_rate.backend: 78% (14/18, 1 skipped; 4 template failures are all downstream of the LLM budget issue)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (auth + register + dashboard + pricing + stripe redirect verified; generator end-to-end blocked by LLM key)

test_credentials: admin@sitegenie.com / admin123 (verified working). New user registration also works.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests register users with emails like test_<uuid>@example.com and generate a template using the admin account (this test currently fails due to LLM budget). No manual seed data needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. It uses pytest-xdist parallel by default (fine). The single skipped test (0-credit 402) was intentionally skipped for runtime; can be enabled once LLM works by draining a fresh user's 3 credits then asserting 402 on the 4th generate. Frontend route for generator is /generate (NOT /generator). Sidebar 'Generate' link works. Google login button exists (data-testid=google-login-btn) but was not exercised in this run since credentials + register cover auth.
rca of the issue: RCA for /api/templates/generate 502: backend logs (/var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log) show 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0' bubbling out of emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat.send_message. Reproduction: POST /api/templates/generate with valid session and credits > 0. Mitigation: refresh/top-up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env. Optional code hardening: detect BadRequestError containing 'Budget has been exceeded' in server.py's try/except (line 256-260) and immediately raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='LLM temporarily unavailable') to avoid the ingress 502.
